initialBuild.title: Barbarian/Fishing
initialBuild.description:
Everything listed below is "in order" of priority

# DAMAGE PRESET

## TAB 1

- [[talent:6]] -> [[talent:5]] -> 50 points [[talent:88]] -> [[talent:86]] -> [[talent:0]] -> [[talent:10]]
- [[talent:12]] (upgrade according to accuracy needed)

## TAB 2

- 25 points [[talent:90]] = 25 points [[talent:91]] = 45 points [[talent:93]] = 1 point [[talent:94]] 
- [[talent:97]] -> [[talent:95]] -> [[talent:92]] -> [[talent:96]] = [[talent:98]] 
- Any additional points put in [[talent:94]]

## TAB 3

- 25 points [[talent:105]] = 25 points [[talent:106]] 
- (Wait until World 4 before leveling [[talent:108]] , you need enough base HP to avoid one shot) -> [[talent:81]] -> [[talent:110]] (only breakpoint)
- [[talent:119]] -> [[talent:109]] ----- -> [[talent:111]] = [[talent:112]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:620]] -> [[talent:616]] (capped at 10% of highest level - ie level 100 means skill level 10)
- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:624]] = [[talent:627]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:638]] (More dungeon = more damage) -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
- Optional: [[talent:632]] , [[talent:629]] [[talent:640]]

-----

# SKILLING PRESET

## TAB 1

- [[talent:85]] -> [[talent:89]] -> [[talent:10]]
- Optional from here on out: [[talent:8]]

## TAB 2

- [[talent:98]] -> [[talent:94]] -> [[talent:96]] (low conversion rate) -> [[talent:99]] -> [[talent:104]]

## TAB 3

- [[talent:115]] -> [[talent:116]] -> [[talent:117]] -> [[talent:118]] -> [[talent:81]] -> [[talent:112]] 
- [[talent:111]] or if need Tab 2 points [[talent:119]]

## TAB 4

- [[talent:149]] -> [[talent:143]] -> [[talent:142]] 
- Optional from here on out: Mostly Cooking skills

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:625]] = [[talent:620]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:636]] -> [[talent:637]] -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
